title: Background sync workers fetch via datasource proxy (dsproxyclient)
answers: How should a background job fetch config from a datasource?
Where is the shared logic for proxying a sync-worker request through Grafana's datasource proxy?
Why doesn't ExternalAMSyncer / external ruler syncer manage its own HTTP transport anymore?
body: Background jobs that need to call out to a datasource (external ruler sync, external Alertmanager sync) go through pkg/services/ngalert/dsproxyclient.Client instead of building their own http.RoundTripper/validator. Client.Get(ctx, ds) builds a service-identity context+user, synthesizes a ReqContext, and calls proxy.ProxyDatasourceRequestWithUID, so TLS, auth, headers and egress/allow-deny-list validation all live in the datasource proxy service, not the caller. Status-code interpretation (e.g. what a 404 means) stays with each caller via the returned Result{Status,Body} since semantics differ per API.
applies: ngalert background sync workers (or any new one) that need to fetch data from a Grafana datasource without a live user request.
